card.name: Spreadsheet and software interface instructions
card.fires_on: Small words such as "the", "in", "such" or "and" in step-by-step software instructions (Excel, Word dialog boxes, toolbars). It also fires on the space before a numeric threshold like >1,000 or 15%.

modes.label: Software how-to text
modes.description: Small linking words in instructions about clicking dialog boxes, cells and toolbars.

modes.description: The space just before a threshold number in lab or concentration cutoffs.

card.writes: It suppresses spreadsheet words like sheet, sheets, range and ranges, so the model is less likely to continue with them.
card.plain: It fires on small words in computer how-to steps and before cutoff numbers, and it holds back spreadsheet words like "sheet" or "range".
